result.title: PromptSMC: Enabling Particle Exploration in Flow Matching via LLM-Based Prompt Rejuvenation
result.summary: This paper is concerned with prompt-image alignment at inference time through exploration of generative trajectories and dynamical prompt rejuvenation. We leverage sequential Monte Carlo (SMC), to offer a gradient-free and principled framework for this purpose through reward-guided trajectory selection. More specifically, we introduce LLM-based prompt rejuvenation, allowing for efficient particle exploration in SMC samplers along the diffusion time in flow matching models. The proposed method, PromptSMC, retains the selected latent states and uses a pretrained LLM to dynamically revise the prompts of duplicated particles under semantic-preservation constraints. These revised prompts induce alternative conditional velocity fields, allowing particles to explore different continuations from a shared intermediate state. The method further uses a reward model to evaluate each particle's alignment with the original prompt, and the resulting scores guide particles through resampling. PromptSMC thus integrates prompt-based exploration with reward-guided sampling, achieving faithful prompt-image alignment without additional noise injection, model training, or reward gradients. Our experiments and ablation studies across multiple benchmarks and backbones demonstrate the effectiveness of the method for text-to-image flow matching. Code is available at https://github.com/shermanlian/PromptSMC.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文面向 text-to-image flow matching 的推理期提示—图像对齐，提出 PromptSMC：用序贯蒙特卡洛从共享中间 latent 状态复制粒子，借助预训练 LLM 在语义保持约束下改写各粒子提示以产生不同速度场，再用奖励模型打分并重采样优选轨迹，无需训练或奖励梯度。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属图像生成，但其「保留中间 latent、分叉多假设粒子、按奖励重采样」的机制可能为 LVR 的多 latent 假设维护、证据筛选与停止决策提供可供核查的思路。
